capability_argument_policy: sole argument, handled before logger/config/cache initialization

fields.parent_pid: positive platform PID, equal to current getppid and connected kernel peer PID
fields.parent_uid: current effective UID and connected kernel peer UID
fields.socket: canonical runtime_base/a<32 lowercase hex UUID>/r; runtime_base is canonical /tmp (/private/tmp on Darwin) with sticky ownership semantics
fields.deadline_monotonic_ms: absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC milliseconds, copied unchanged from original end-to-end native startup descriptor deadline; positive remaining budget at most10000ms

descriptor.file_policy: root/r.json, private owned regular single-link file, no-follow bounded read; canonical base safe UID/sticky mode and root0700/socket0600 inode checks before and after connect

frames.accepted_teardown: Frontend reporter validates accepted3 then closes channel and finishes; CLI must observe EOF/recheck full child identity/cancellation/fixed deadline before forwarding observer4Ready. Actual frontend remains alive.

emission.first_condition: main consumed DoneParsingStdinQuery and actual shared parser.should_parse is false under its mutex
emission.second_condition: first typed server Render after that transition completed every stdout write and flush successfully
emission.early_render: cannot satisfy second condition before first condition
emission.main_thread: nonblocking try_send only; no control I/O or wait
emission.reporter: one owned joined thread, fixed shared monotonic deadline and cancellation; partial nonblocking control I/O, no user input or terminal markers
emission.deadline_clock: actual CLOCK_MONOTONIC milliseconds on both peers; never Rust Instant epoch

authentication.frontend_checks: kernel socket parent PID/UID equal descriptor and current direct parent, nonce, attachment ID, inode/type/mode/deadline; retain connected parent through accepted
authentication.CLI_checks_required_by_integrator: kernel peer full exact retained frontend identity PID/UID/parent/start/boot/configured image, nonce, attachment/owner generation, namespace/socket identity and current cancellation/deadline
authentication.macos_peer_pid: public LOCAL_PEERPID getsockopt wrapper with exact output size; no interprocess1.2.1 peer_pid fallback because it is unsupported on Darwin

integration_boundary.scope: dependency reporter only; no core/runtime edits, package acquisition or native default activation
integration_boundary.deadline_ownership: Native coordinator computes absolutemonoms once at namespace creation from original remaining startup budget; observer4 carries it; CLI min(localbudget,nativedeadline) and forwards same absolute deadline unchanged. No progress/reconnect refresh.

environment_capture: Root main captures/removes variable as its first operation before logger, config/cache, threads or subprocess paths; passes owned optional path through commands::start_client to library, no global storage
